name: trip-itinerary
description: Builds a multi-city trip itinerary at three activity levels and three travel budget tiers. A door skill acts as lead and spawns exactly one subagent per stop — a city plus its inbound travel leg — in parallel, with no nesting: each subagent researches its own stop and writes a single JSON shard to disk. The lead then runs one build script that reads every shard off disk and assembles the deliverables, an xlsx workbook and a markdown itinerary, without any shard's contents entering a model's context.
